name: Word-count CSV after export
description: An export hook. After an export it counts the words in the exported file and writes a small CSV report next to it. It sees only a read-only copy of the exported file and the loss report, never the master document.
author: ByAuthorX project

export_hooks.title: Word-count CSV
export_hooks.description: Writes <file>.wordcount.csv with the word count, size and number of reported losses.
